description: Lists the songs in the calling account's PRIVATE Jam Jam notebook, page by page, oldest update first. fields="summary" (default) gives id, title, artist, key, capo, bpm, playlistIds and updatedAt; fields="full" adds the complete pivot payload (chords, lyrics, sections) and lowers the page cap to 25. Use the returned nextCursor to get the next page, and stop when it is null. Consumes one unit of the daily READ quota (2000/day free, 20000 Premium), never a conversion.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous call's `nextCursor`. Replay it verbatim; never build one.

fields.description: "summary" (default) or "full" to include the complete song payload.

limit.description: Page size, default 30, hard cap 100 (25 when fields="full").

updatedSince.description: ISO 8601 date. Returns only objects STRICTLY newer (updatedAt > updatedSince). Keep the largest updatedAt you received and pass it back next time for an incremental export.

name: jj_list_songs
title: List my notebook songs
